p1: Security cameras filmed him walking into a bar. Not one camera ever saw him walk out.
Columbus, Ohio. April 2006. Brian Shaffer, 27. A medical student.
His mother had died three weeks earlier. In two days, he was flying to Miami with his girlfriend.
Just after 1 a.m., a camera filmed him riding the escalator up to the bar.
Just before 2, he was on camera again. Talking with two women.
The bar closed at 2. His friends waited outside. He never came out.
Police went through the footage. Not one frame shows him leaving.
The only other way out was a service door. Nobody knows if he used it.
Months later, his phone briefly came back on. The phone company called it a glitch.
20 years later, Brian Shaffer has never been found.
He walked into that bar... and never walked out.
